glad: We are glad you are ready to serve and make a generational impact in your community, Africa and the diaspora.
intro: This short guide walks you through your own dashboard, step by step, and shows you exactly what to tap.

scenes.text: This is your dashboard. It shows your area at a glance: your members, your chapters, and what needs you today.
To move around, tap More, at the bottom right of the screen. It opens the full menu.
The menu lists every page. Tap Tasks to see the work given to you.
Open a task and read what is asked. Tap View to open the document attached to it.
When the work is done, tap Upload the finished work, and choose the file from your phone.
Then tap Submit for review. The person who gave you the task is told at once.
For your monthly report, tap Reporting, at the bottom of the screen.
Fill in the report. Then tap Upload the report document, and choose your PDF or Word file.
Tap Submit report. WODDI headquarters is told by notification and email.
To write to someone, open Messages, and tap New message.
Choose who receives it: one person, or a group by network, leadership level or region. Write, then tap Send. You have thirty seconds to undo.
To hold a video meeting, open Video meetings in the menu, and tap Ask for a video meeting. Fill in the form, and send it to headquarters.
You can add a meeting flier to your request: tap Upload the meeting flier, and choose a picture or a PDF. Everyone invited sees it on the meeting page.
As soon as headquarters approves, the meeting is open. Tap Join the video meeting. The call opens inside WDOS. Allow your camera and microphone.
Tell your people from the same page. Choose people in WDOS, and tap Notify the people I chose. They are told in the app, on the phone and by email.
Or tap Copy meeting link, and paste it in WhatsApp or any chat.
After the meeting, write the minutes here. Tick the leaders who attended, add the minutes document or a recording, and send. The leaders and headquarters receive them in the app and by email.
The bell at the top shows what is new. Tap it to see your notifications.
Change your language here, at the top of every page.
Tap Listen to hear the page read aloud.
You are ready. You can open this guide again from the menu, under How to use WDOS. No woman is left out.
